facts.event: Tilde 在尾声给母亲（Rivani 王太后）写信，说两人分别还不到六个「月」，世事却已大变
facts.relation: 女儿 Tilde → 母亲、Merogia 的 Rivani 女王
facts.numbers: Not six moons have passed（未满六个月）
facts.anchor: Not six moons have passed since we parted, and yet so much has changed

facts.event: Tilde 向母亲宣告自己已经夺权，并用 Ways 的魔法除掉了国王的儿子们
facts.relation: Tilde 与国王之子（她丈夫的儿子们）为敌，已将其清除
facts.anchor: Mother, I have done it. I have taken command, and have rid his sons with the magic of the Ways.

facts.event: Tilde 说自己怀着国王的孩子（一个王子），日日祈祷他强壮，并盼国王随之好转、Cynghal 免于倾覆
facts.relation: Tilde 怀着丈夫（国王）的继承人
facts.numbers: 无（a.pray daily 为频率表述）
facts.anchor: I am blessed, at least, by his growing prince inside me.

facts.event: 她称一些叛乱的 markals 趁国王病弱封锁了 Hallion 与通往 Falcan 的要道，但 Cynghal、Galen、Merogia 三国合力将逼其投降
facts.relation: 叛乱的 markals 对阵 Cynghal／Galen／Merogia 联盟
facts.anchor: Some rebellious markals take advantage of the king’s distress, closing off cold Hallion, and the hannerest to Falcan

facts.event: 她宣告 Marolyn 已归于神恩、众人哀悼这位「我们族人真正的战士、至忠的侍女」
facts.relation: Marolyn 是 Tilde 身边忠心的侍女／同族战士，已死
facts.anchor: Marolyn has been taken into god’s grace.

facts.event: 她提到公主已出逃且至今未被找到，随后以「天鹅女王 Tilde」的身份落款
facts.relation: Tilde 与出逃的公主（王位对手）；落款自称天鹅女王
facts.anchor: The princess has fled, and has not yet been found.
